title: Минимум
verify: SELECT 'a' AS kind, func_minimum(VARIADIC arr => ARRAY[10.0, -1.0, 5.0, 4.4])::float8::text AS v UNION ALL SELECT 'b', func_minimum(VARIADIC arr => ARRAY[7.5])::float8::text UNION ALL SELECT 'c', func_minimum(VARIADIC arr => ARRAY[-5.0, -10.0, 3.0])::float8::text UNION ALL SELECT 'd', func_minimum(3.5, 2.25, 9.0)::float8::text ORDER BY 1

positive.sql: CREATE FUNCTION func_minimum(VARIADIC arr numeric[]) RETURNS numeric AS $$ DECLARE m numeric; x numeric; BEGIN FOREACH x IN ARRAY arr LOOP IF m IS NULL OR x < m THEN m := x; END IF; END LOOP; RETURN m; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

negative.sql: CREATE FUNCTION func_minimum(VARIADIC arr numeric[]) RETURNS numeric AS $$ SELECT arr[1]; $$ LANGUAGE sql;
